description: Utility class providing static methods for handling field expressions within the Eclipse Ditto model query framework. Includes methods for wrapping fields in regex, identifying attribute and definition fields, and parsing feature fields.

classes.name: FieldExpressionUtil
classes.description: Final utility class for field expressions, providing constants and static methods.

methods.name: wrapExistsRegex
methods.description: Wraps the given field in a regex with a start anchor and an end delimiter (/ or end-of-line).

methods.name: parseFeatureField
methods.description: Parses a feature field name into a FeatureField object, returning an Optional.

methods.name: isAttributeFieldName
methods.description: Checks if the provided field name is an attribute field.

methods.name: stripAttributesPrefix
methods.description: Removes the 'attributes/' prefix from a field name.

methods.name: isDefinitionFieldName
methods.description: Checks if the provided field name is a definition field.

methods.name: addAttributesPrefix
methods.description: Adds the 'attributes/' prefix to a field name.

inner_classes.name: FeatureField
inner_classes.description: Represents a feature field with optional featureId and property, capable of pattern matching derived field names.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the feature ID.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the property path.

methods.name: FieldExpressionUtil.wrapExistsRegex
methods.description: Wraps a field string into a regex pattern that matches fields starting with the given string.

methods.name: FieldExpressionUtil.parseFeatureField
methods.description: Attempts to parse a feature field name into a FeatureField object.

methods.name: FieldExpressionUtil.isAttributeFieldName
methods.description: Checks whether a given field name starts with 'attributes/'.

methods.name: FieldExpressionUtil.stripAttributesPrefix
methods.description: Removes the 'attributes/' prefix from a field name.

methods.name: FieldExpressionUtil.isDefinitionFieldName
methods.description: Checks whether a given field name starts with 'definition/'.
